description: This is a CMake module script used to find and configure the external library 'Glib' (specifically glib-2.0). It checks for the presence of the library, its headers, and sets relevant variables for use in CMake build scripts.

methods.name: find_package
methods.description: Finds the PkgConfig package required for locating glib-2.0.

methods.name: pkg_check_modules
methods.description: Checks for the presence of the glib-2.0 module via pkg-config.

methods.name: find_path
methods.description: Locates the header files 'glib.h' and 'glibconfig.h' in the include directories.

methods.name: include
methods.description: Includes other CMake modules, such as FindPackageHandleStandardArgs.

methods.name: find_package_handle_standard_args
methods.description: Handles the standard logic for checking if required components are found.

methods.name: mark_as_advanced
methods.description: Marks variables as advanced to hide them in GUIs.
